entities.name: Ulises Solís
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Ulises Solís Pérez is a Mexican former professional boxer who competed from 2000 to 2013. He held the IBF junior flyweight title twice in his career from 2006 to 2009 and from 2011 to 2012. He is the brother of former boxer Jorge Solís.
